name: Stella Core
description: Stella 3.0 cognitive runtime: Personal Twin, Framework Runtime, Reality Intelligence, and Praxis Loop

initializationGatewayAccess.description: Explicit permission to verify initialization through the local authenticated Gateway using operator.read; credentials remain in Host configuration.

canghaiRoot.description: Absolute path to the local CangHai checkout

manifestPath.description: Path to the Stella consciousness manifest relative to CangHai root

recoveryRevision.description: Exact clean CangHai Git commit selected as the recovery revision

agentId.description: OpenClaw agent id that Stella Core should augment

durabilityRemote.description: Explicit Git remote used only by managed_durable_write

durabilityBranch.description: Explicit Git branch used only by managed_durable_write

archiveRetention.description: Opt in to native-maintenance hold checks and continuous archive backlog monitoring for the configured agent; requires session.maintenance.mode=warn and managed durability. Does not authorize deletion or certify all historical generations.

contextHistorySignerId.description: Pinned Ed25519 public key identity for Core history; initialize the private key outside CangHai before enabling managed context.

contextHistoryArchiveRoot.description: Repository-relative retained Core context archive directory; requires managed durable writes and a pinned signing key.

recoveryAuthority.description: Explicit authority mode. Core checkpoint is restricted maintenance; Agent memory is blocked until migrated.

checkpointStateDirectory.description: Explicit existing canonical state directory outside CangHai, required only in core_checkpoint mode. Never auto-initialized.

requestArchive.description: Explicit checkpoint-mode owner ingress retention only; commits locally and does not run an Agent or deliver a generated reply.
